name: Yoga school in Prague
reason: No in-scope school found in three searches. Prague Yoga Collective (pragueyogacollective.com, found via its Squarespace address; robots allows us; 200/300-hour Yoga Alliance trainings) was opened but is a four-studio English-language studio business sold as 'strong, stretchy & fun' classes, with Barre, Strength & Mobility, Rocket and hot-yoga roots, MultiSport fitness cards and prenatal classes, and no lineage or spiritual framing: treated as fitness-led and out of scope (owner may disagree). Lineage names (Iyengar Yoga Institute Praha, Traditional Ashtanga Praha, Prague Yoga founded 2004) appeared only in directories (firmy.cz, ashtangayoga.info, lifestyle guides) without a teacher training or own site confirmed within the search limit.
